name: HR holiday observance policy example
answer:
Employees receive paid time off for company-observed holidays.
Employees receive 15 paid holidays each year.
Employees receive free commuter parking.

sources.title: HR Holiday Observance Policy
sources.content:
Employees receive paid time off for company-observed holidays.
The company observes 11 paid holidays each year.
Unused holiday time does not carry into the next calendar year.
